classification: Additive Band Protocol v3 oracle integration and append-only coverage policy v3; no partner activation
receiptImpact: Adds BandChain v3 Concurrent Price Stream observations as an explicit BandChain-scoped, unsigned REST source and adds strict-300s.v3 with Band as its own reviewed non-derived source group. Existing signed layouts, registry release, partner policies, activation mappings, coverage v1/v2 policy bytes and historical receipts are unchanged. Band REST observations cannot be relabelled as EVM-chain evidence and remain subject to exact evidence-chain matching.
activationRule: No partner policy or activation mapping changes. Band price retrieval is an additive public oracle source. Coverage v3 requires explicit consumer adoption and independent pinning; existing consumers remain on their current policies. This promotion does not claim partner acceptance, EVM-native Band verification, continuous upstream availability or achieved production SLOs.

compatibilityMatrix.evidence: Existing immutable policy, activation, signed layouts and fixtures remain unchanged. Band and coverage v3 are additive opt-in surfaces and are not invoked automatically. No partner sign-off or new production data coverage is claimed.
